// Generated companion for the private P03 FAQ adaptation.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

type FAQItem struct {
	Key, Question, Answer string
	Open                  bool
}

type FAQ struct {
	IDPrefix, Heading string
	Items             []FAQItem
}

// NewFAQReference preserves the source Elements structure. Its host must supply
// the exact runtime named by the generation artifact.
func NewFAQReference(data FAQ) (templ.Component, error) {
	return newFAQ(data, false)
}

// NewFAQDetails renders independent native disclosures and needs no JavaScript.
func NewFAQDetails(data FAQ) (templ.Component, error) {
	return newFAQ(data, true)
}

func newFAQ(data FAQ, details bool) (templ.Component, error) {
	if !faqIdentity(data.IDPrefix, true) || !faqText(data.Heading, 256, false) || len(data.Items) < 1 || len(data.Items) > 24 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("faq: invalid prefix, heading, or item count")
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(data.Items))
	for _, item := range data.Items {
		if !faqIdentity(item.Key, false) || seen[item.Key] || !faqText(item.Question, 512, false) || !faqText(item.Answer, 8192, true) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("faq: invalid or duplicate item")
		}
		seen[item.Key] = true
	}
	data.Items = append([]FAQItem(nil), data.Items...)
	component := faqReference(data)
	if details {
		component = faqDetails(data)
	}
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return component.Render(ctx, w)
	}), nil
}

func faqIdentity(s string, prefix bool) bool {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for i, c := range []byte(s) {
		letter := c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'
		digit := c >= '0' && c <= '9'
		if prefix && i == 0 && !letter || !letter && !digit && c != '_' && !(prefix && c == '-') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func faqText(s string, limit int, answer bool) bool {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > limit || !utf8.ValidString(s) || strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) && !(answer && (r == '\t' || r == '\n')) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func faqPanelID(prefix, key string) string { return prefix + "-" + key }

func faqReferenceItems(data FAQ) templ.Component {
	return faqItems(data, false)
}

func faqDetailsItems(data FAQ) templ.Component {
	return faqItems(data, true)
}

func faqItems(data FAQ, details bool) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		for i, item := range data.Items {
			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if i > 0 {
				separator := faqReferenceSeparator
				if details {
					separator = "\n"
				}
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, separator); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			component := faqReferenceItem(data, item)
			if details {
				component = faqDetailsItem(data, item)
			}
			if err := component.Render(ctx, w); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
}
